guitar.evidence: Josh Homme is well documented playing a Maton BB1200; Troy Van Leeuwen is associated with Fender Jazzmasters/Ovation. The original 'Ovation Ultra GP' is a less commonly cited detail.
guitar.notes: Streamlined model list to the most consistently documented instruments.

tone.target: dry stoner-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite and upper-mid grind
tone.profile: dry stoner-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite and upper-mid grind
tone.summary: A tight, aggressive stoner rock tone built around a fuzz drive into a Plexi-style amp and 4x12 cab, emphasizing upper-mids for grind.
corrections: lean drier than generic desert rock
favor fuzz bite over TS overdrive

rig.name: Queens Of The Stone Age - 3's and 7's - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and noise inherent in high-gain fuzz tones.
Provides the necessary tight, crunchy fuzz bite and aggressive upper-mid grind.
Slightly boosts the signal into the amp section to maintain riff-forward attack and punch.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used here for general tone shaping/punch, as a dedicated EQ might be too broad after fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Simulates the Plexi/Marshall-style amp head required for classic stoner rock grit and upper-mid bite.
Provides the classic Marshall-style 4x12 cabinet sound.
Sculpts the upper-mids specifically to achieve the required 'upper-mid grind' and bite.
Included as a potential utility module for dynamic tone shaping (though kept off for the dry stoner sound).
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is included to fulfill the required WAH/None slot, but it should remain inactive.

blocks.purpose: Kept minimal and off to avoid 'big delay' or lush ambience, maintaining a dry feel.
blocks.gap: The module is included but deactivated to meet the requirement while adhering to the 'avoid big delay' rule.

blocks.purpose: Provides the absolute minimum amount of ambience (low ambience) without sounding lush or wet.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and upper-mid articulation.

proposals.reason: Enhance the perceived depth and grit of the Marshall cab tone.
